newsitem.title: IRAN: Ousted Afghan leader arrives in Iran.
newsitem.headline: Ousted Afghan leader arrives in Iran.

text.p: Afghanistan's ousted president Burhanuddin Rabbani arrived in Tehran on Thursday for talks with President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani and other high-ranking Iranian officials, Iran's official news agency IRNA said.
It said they would discuss developments in Afghanistan and relations between Tehran and Kabul.
Rabbani, whose government was driven out of the Afghan capital on September 27 by radical Islamic Taleban militia, is supported by Iran. He last visited Tehran on November 11.
The Taleban, who aim to spread strict Islamic sharia law throughout Afghanistan, control at least two-thirds of the country and say Rabbani's government no longer exists.
Shi'ite Moslem Iran brands the Sunni Taleban as rebels whose excesses give Islam a bad name. It has called for dialogue among all the factions in Afghanistan.
